And when he was unable to enter from the side of the banks of the Euphrates,
he went up above the cliff,
and from there let down men with ropes.
And the monks were afraid,
and went out to him.
And he took complete control,
and plundered all the sacred treasure that was found:
chalices,
and silver bowls,
and crosses,
and everything that had been there from the time of Mar John, Patriarch bar Abdun.
And he also took the physic {OCR?}.
And he transferred Rabban David the Solitary and his companions to the Monastery of Shira,
and no one remained except Abu Ghalib at the table of the king.

and he received him with honor.
And both of them went,
and took Hamadan from Sultan Mas'ud.
From there that Rashid went against Isfahan,
and fell ill there with a severe illness.
And while he was ill,
four Khurasanian men came upon him,
and killed him at the gate of Isfahan.
It is said,
that even if he had not been killed,
he was soon about to die of his illness,
because he had been given deadly poison to drink three times.
And he was buried at the gate of Isfahan where he was killed,
just as his father also was at the gate of Maragha,
where he was killed.
And in the year
1449 of the Greeks [1138 AD],
while Edessa was as if under siege by the Turks,
three hundred Frankish knights gathered,
and about four thousand foot soldiers, combatants and others,
and set out from Samosata,
and went to bring provisions into Edessa.
And an ambush of Timurtash, the lord of Mardin, came out against them,
and most of the Christians were killed,
and the rest were carried off as slaves.
Now there were present with them Abu Sa'd the deacon, a physician and philosopher,
and Michael bar Shmuna and his son.
And that Timurtash also took the fortress of Kesun from the Franks.
And Mas'ud of Iconium entered the territory of Kaysum,
and took captives and burned the villages.
And in the year 533,
533 of the Arabs [1138/9 AD],
in the second month,
there was a severe earthquake in Ganza (in Ghazna?), a city of the Persians,
and two hundred and thirty thousand souls perished in it.
And that city was completely overturned,
and black waters welled up from it.
